info.name: School Management Backend API
info.description:
Complete API collection for School Management System Backend

**Authentication:**
- Uses Supabase JWT token authentication
- Token expires after 30 minutes
- Login automatically saves access_token and refresh_token
- Logout invalidates token at Supabase level
- All protected APIs require Authorization header: Bearer {{access_token}}

**Public APIs:**
- GET /api/results - Get student result (no auth required)
- GET /api/marks/result - Get student result (no auth required)

**Protected APIs:**
- All other APIs require authentication
- Admin only: Fees, Bills, Invoice, Subject management, User management
- Admin & Teacher: Students, Marks, Subjects (read)

item.name: About Bills Endpoints
item.description:
The Bills API manages fee bill generation and retrieval for students with automatic advance deduction.

**Available Endpoints:**
- GET /api/bills/download-data: Fetch bills for a month with advance and payment details
- POST /api/bills/generate: Generate bills for all students in a class with automatic FIFO advance application

**Advance Handling (FIFO - First In First Out):**
- During bill generation, system scans for active (status='active') advances in student's ledger
- Applies advances in order created to reduce net_payable
- Fully consumed advances: marked as status='used', used_for_bill_id set, used_at recorded
- Partially consumed advances: amount reduced, status remains 'active', used_for_bill_id tracked to prevent double usage
- Advance deduction shown as negative line item in bill

**Bill Calculation Flow:**
1. Base Fee = tuition + optional fees (exam/annual/computer) + transport
2. Total Amount = Base Fee + previous dues
3. Total Advance Used = sum of active advances applied (FIFO)
4. Net Payable = Total Amount - Total Advance Used
5. Bill Status = 'paid' (net_payable=0) | 'partial' (advance used) | 'unpaid'

**Key Features:**
- Prevents generation for closed months
- Creates itemized bills with all fee components
- Automatically tracks advance consumption
- Ensures no duplicate advance usage on bill regeneration
- Shows advance deductions clearly in invoices and bill downloads
